bank.retain_mission: Durable knowledge that holds across repositories: the user's working preferences and conventions, how their tools and environment behave (shell, editor, version and package managers, terminal multiplexer, containers, coding agents), and engineering lessons that would help in any codebase. Keep tool names, commands, versions, and other exact identifiers from the source in the extracted facts.
bank.reflect_mission: I am the long-term memory of one developer's coding agents. I know their preferences, their tools and environment, and the lessons they have learned across projects, so an agent can work the way they would and avoid repeating past mistakes.
